what: every 512 MiB copy draw behind the placement finding, pooled, so the claim rests on a committed artifact rather than on a chat message
why: @Autotune's feasible band for the unarchived 4.89 copy denominator is [4.8850, 4.8950], 0.2% wide, and he observed that every committed copy value misses it. Each of those values is a SINGLE allocation's draw. These 25 draws show what a single draw is worth at this size: the distribution straddles the band. The band is not excluded by the data.
op: c.copy_(a), five identically-sized identically-filled sources, one fixed destination

runs.source: roofline generator, shipped artifact at this commit

provenance_note: The first four runs came from throwaway scripts, which is the same defect class this section is about -- a number whose only home was a message. They are recorded here verbatim as transcribed from those runs' stdout; only the fifth is regenerable from committed code (copy_variability in the roofline sidecar). Treat the first four as transcribed, and re-derive the finding from the fifth plus any new run if the distinction matters.

pooled.verdict: The confound exceeds every gap the argument discriminates, so a single committed copy value can neither confirm nor exclude a historical copy figure at this size. This removes an argument against 4.89; it does not restore it, whose provenance remains absent.
